title: ELF_IMEIJ_Backdoor_Investigation_188
description: Investigate a potential backdoor malware infection on a target system.

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The target system has exhibited unusual network activity and performance degradation. Initial analysis suggests a potential ELF_IMEIJ backdoor malware infection. Your task is to investigate, identify, and mitigate the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content: You have SSH access to the target system with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`. The target system is named `target` and is reachable at `192.168.50.5`. To proceed to the next level, enter the word 'start'.
levels.local_content: Local sandbox access is not required for this scenario.

levels.title: Suspicious Service Discovery
levels.content: Investigate the target system and identify any unauthorized or suspicious services running on the host.
levels.solution: Check the status of all running services and look for any that are not part of the standard system configuration.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Check the status of all running services and look for any that are not part of the standard system configuration.

levels.title: Persistence Discovery
levels.content: Determine how the suspicious service is automatically started after reboot.
levels.solution: Examine the systemd service files and timers to find any suspicious configurations.

hints.title: First hint title
hints.content: Examine the systemd service files and timers to find any suspicious configurations.

levels.title: C2 Communication Discovery (Port)
levels.content: Determine which network port is used for the suspicious communication.
levels.solution: Check the network connections and listen ports to identify any unusual activity.
